metadata.note: A basemap with nothing in it. No tiles, no glyphs, no sprite, no host but this one: a background colour and nothing else. Everything you see over it is drawn by this project from its own files, the buildings from data/figure.json, the streets from data/streets.json, the ideal ring and the districts from data/geography.json. It exists for the space-time cube, where a borrowed basemap under a drawing of time is noise, and for any figure that has to be reproducible offline in ten years.
